documents.quality_note: Official academic integrity policy; the only AI text is the 'AI-Generated Work' entry (not acceptable unless authorized by instructor/administrator). Restricts by default.

notes: The only official IUP AI policy text found is the one-sentence AI-Generated Work clause above (also quoted on libraryguides.lib.iup.edu/c.php?g=1532129&p=11479714, not collected as it only repeats it). Fetched but not collected: iup.edu/president/future/artificial-intelligence.html (strategic-priority project page, generic; mentions Fall 2026 faculty classroom guidance and student-use expectations as planned, no rules) and iup.edu/itsupportcenter news and FAQ on AI language added to IT Acceptable Use, Information Protection and Data Classification policies (IT/data policies; the faq text is at .cache/text/v2-indiana-pennsylvania-itfaq.txt if a reviewer wants it). A search summary said the IT-news page describes instructor-discretion classroom guidance, but I did not verify that in fetched text. Computing: COSC department has no AI policy found.
